title: Growth Account Manager
description:
DESCRIPTION

About DoorLoop

DoorLoop is property management software built for speed and the smart choice for people who take growth seriously. With offices in Miami, New York City, and Tel Aviv, we’re a global company helping property owners and managers move faster, scale smarter, and get real support, real fast.

We’re proudly People First. That’s why we’re a Certified Great Place to Work, recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Startup Employers (2024 & 2025), and highly rated on Glassdoor.

 

Mission

DoorLoop is hiring one of its first Growth Account Managers to help pilot a new post-sale upsell motion, selling our AI products into our existing customer base.

Responsibilities

 - Own a book of existing customers and proactively reach out to upsell products they do not currently use.

 - Run the full sales cycle on each account: outreach, discovery, demo, and close.

 - Hit daily activity targets, book and run demos, and carry a monthly upsell revenue quota.

 - Flag and help resolve open customer issues with Support before pushing an upsell conversation.

 - Help build the playbook: scripts, cadences, objection handling, and the process future growth account managers will ramp on.

 - Give direct feedback on what is and is not working, since the motion is still being proven out.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Intrinsically motivated and comfortable being held accountable to daily activity, demos, and a monthly quota.

 - Full-cycle sales experience: you have run your own conversations from outreach to close.

 - A demonstrated ability to understand customer needs deeply and use that understanding to grow the account, through upsell, expansion, or improving ARR.

 - Adaptable and willing to learn. This is a new pilot, and you will help shape the process rather than inherit one.

 - A builder mentality: comfortable without a fully built-out system, and energized by creating one.

 - Motivated to grow with the organization as the team scales.

Nice to Have

 - Nice to have: experience helping launch a new team or motion from scratch, in an environment without an established process.


BENEFITS

 - Unlimited paid time off: take unlimited personal, sick, and vacation days.

 - 401(k): plan for retirement with 4% matching and instant vesting.

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance: we offer full medical coverage for employees through United Healthcare and full dental and vision coverage through Guardian, with 25% coverage for dependents across all plans.

 - Life insurance: $100,000 policy fully covered by DoorLoop.

 - Disability insurance: short- and long-term disability insurance fully covered by DoorLoop.

 - Paid parental leave: paid maternity and paternity leave for birth and adoption.

 - Monthly stipend: a dedicated budget for work-related expenses.

 - Best-in-class equipment: Get a company laptop and all the top-tier tools to set you up for success.

 


COMPENSATION RANGE

This role offers a total target compensation (OTE) of $120,000–$140,000, structured as a 50/50 split ($60k–$70k Base / $60k–$70k Variable).

We use AI-assisted tools, including assessment tools that evaluate cognitive ability and personality fit, to help evaluate applications. Human oversight is maintained and no hiring decision is made solely by an automated system. title: Client Onboarding Specialist
description:
OUR MISSION

ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.

 


OUR SOLUTION 

Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.

 


OUR CULTURE & VALUES

Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

ButterflyMX is seeking a Client Onboarding Specialist to help new and existing clients successfully onboard, understand, and use our products. This client-facing role combines thoughtful communication, strong organization, and technical aptitude to create a smooth onboarding experience.

You will work directly with clients to coordinate onboarding activities, provide training, support product setup and integrations, and address questions along the way. You will partner across internal teams to keep work moving, maintain visibility into open requests, and help clients feel confident using ButterflyMX.

Success in this role requires ownership, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. You will manage multiple priorities, solve problems as they arise, and help improve the processes and resources that make client onboarding more effective as we scale.

 - Guide new and existing clients through onboarding by communicating key steps, setting clear expectations, and helping teams understand how to use ButterflyMX solutions through email, phone, and video support.

 - Support clients through product setup, integrations, troubleshooting, onboarding challenges, and engaging internal teams when needed.

 - Maintain accurate records, ticket updates, and onboarding documentation to ensure work is visible and actionable.

 - Identify and provide feedback on recurring questions, onboarding friction, and opportunities to improve client education, processes, and resources.

 - 2+ years of experience in client onboarding, client support, customer service, or a similar client-facing role, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.

 - Experience using Zendesk or another ticketing platform to manage client requests, document interactions, and track resolutions.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.

 - Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn new products, systems, and integrations.

 - A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with reliable follow-through and sound judgment.

 - Knowledge of property management, proptech, or hardware-enabled SaaS is a plus.

 - Proven experience with leveraging AI tools in both professional and personal settings.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
About us 
 Practifi is a client management platform for wealth management firms, built natively on Salesforce. Advice businesses across North America and Australia run their working day inside our product, and the measure we hold ourselves to is whether it makes that day better. Shipping is the easy half. Watching a firm work differently because of it is the part we’re here for. We’re remote-first, and we built the company the way we build the product, with the people who use it in mind.
 The role 
 Our Client Success Managers are the people growing advisory firms call first. You’d own a book of mid-market and growth-stage registered investment advisers (RIAs): firms that are adding advisors, acquiring practices, and leaning on their technology to keep up.
 The work is relationship-led. Firms that are healthy, well-adopted, and engaged renew and grow on their own, so your attention goes to adoption, client health, and trust rather than a hard sell. Because you’ve worked in financial services, you’d advise on how Practifi should fit the way a firm actually runs, not just how the screens work.
 You’d report to our Head of Revenue and work alongside Account Management, Implementation, Support, and Product. There’s a clear path from here toward Senior and Lead Client Success roles.
 What you’d own 
 A book of client relationships across their lifecycle, as the primary point of contact
 Semi-annual business reviews that tie a firm’s use of Practifi to what it’s trying to achieve
 Renewals, with a Lead or Senior Client Success Manager in your corner when a situation calls for it
 Growth inside your book that comes from adoption, not pressure
 Release readiness for your clients, before and after each release
 45-minute training demonstrations that leave people able to do something new
 Getting complex questions to the right experts fast, and flagging firms that are outgrowing the segment for our Account Management team
 Who we’re hoping to meet 
 Three to five years in client success or account management at a B2B SaaS company, owning a book with renewals attached. At least two years of that, or alongside it, in financial services: at a wealth technology or fintech company, or managing a book of RIA, broker-dealer, or wealth management clients. We’re looking for directly relevant experience. You’ve sat on the software side of the table with financial services clients, and you know how an advisory firm makes decisions, handles compliance pressure, and grows.
 You’re comfortable running a training session for a client audience, and you live in your CRM. Salesforce makes the first few months easier, and so does time with an advisor CRM, portfolio management, or financial planning platform. If AI tools have changed how you manage a book, tell us what changed.
 Mostly, you’re the person who notices a client has gone quiet and reaches out before anyone asks. You’d rather raise a risk early than explain it late.
 Pay and benefits 
 $85,000 to $105,000 base, plus uncapped variable compensation on renewal and expansion revenue. We publish our ranges because we’d rather have that conversation up front than dance around it later.
 Generous time off: 20 days of paid vacation, 10 sick days, 3 personal days, and 3 volunteering days annually
 Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance benefits, plus a 401(k) with company match
 A learning stipend we call Learnbucks, because we couldn’t help ourselves
 A Practibuddy mentor from your first week
 Two company summits a year in Chicago
 How we work 
 Growth, Collaboration, Transparency, Curiosity, and Integrity aren’t posters on a wall here. In this role they look like telling a firm the truth about what isn’t working yet, asking how a firm really operates before recommending anything, and pulling in Support or Product the moment a problem needs them instead of holding onto it. We’d rather hear about a renewal risk early than read about it in a churn report.
 The role is fully remote within the US and does not provide Visa sponsorship (must be legally authorized to work in the US for any employer without sponsorship).
 If that’s the kind of ownership you’re looking for, we’d like to hear from you.

All final hiring decisions are made by our human recruitment team, ensuring fair and thoughtful consideration for every applicant.
